entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Siinamota (椎名もた), otherwise known as Mizoguchi Ryo, was a Japanese keyboardist, lyricist, and composer. He is regarded as one of the most influential Vocaloid producers of all time and is most well known for "Young Girl A". He tends to use soft rock, piano, and electronic rhythms.
